display.purpose: Workspace names and dominant operational context.

label.purpose: Small section markers and status context only.

shadows.name: soft-surface
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift for the primary summary and contextual map.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Small elevated controls in the application shell.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Focus, hover, progress, and state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact lavender commit action with visible focus state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9fa1ff; color: #242642; padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(119 123 227 / 50%); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact field shared by workspace details and folder IDs.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid #d8dcef; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #242642; font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: #777be3; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(119 123 227 / 50%); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Text-led configured or incomplete state marker.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(159 161 255 / 10%); color: #5d5fb7; font: 600 12px/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Open Setting Row
components.description: Divided row for one integration setting with an inline action.
components.css: .ds-setting-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe2f3; } .ds-setting-row strong { display: block; color: #242642; font: 600 14px/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-setting-row small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: #697092; font: 400 12px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-action { color: #5d5fb7; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 12px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-action:hover { background: #eef0ff; }

narrative.overview: Taskory Hub uses a friendly, operational visual language: a cool canvas, soft pastel accents, compact controls, and generous separation between configuration groups. The interface should feel like a dependable team workspace rather than a promotional dashboard. Workspace settings uses one clear status surface at the top, then open sections with quiet dividers.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender action on a cool canvas

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the lavender accent for action and state, not for decorative repetition.

dos: Do lead settings screens with current state and progress before edit controls.
Do group fields by the integration they support.
donts: Don't create a mosaic of equal cards for routine configuration.
Don't use color as the only way to communicate state.
